summary: Draganfly filed a Form 6-K announcing the completed acquisition of Skip Dynamix, adding fixed-wing drone capabilities. The aggregate purchase price was up to US$7,525,000, comprising US$2,525,000 cash at closing, US$2,500,000 in common shares (deemed US$6.46 per share) via a special warrant subject to founder retention, and up to US$2,500,000 in earn-out consideration payable in cash or shares at Draganfly's discretion. No board recommendation or advisor was named. The transaction closed on June 11, 2026. Structural notes include earn-out tied to business milestones and a retention condition on the Payment Shares. Watch for integration progress and milestone achievement for earn-out.
